chunks: And among what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, that he said:

"Whoever the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم granted protection to, then his blood-money is complete." Zurarah said: "So these people?" Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said: "And these are among those whom he granted protection."

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the source of the ruling in this report
key_terms.ذِمَّةً: a covenant of protection or guarantee of security
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Messenger of Allah, whose grant of protection establishes legal standing
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: the narrator who asks for clarification about the included group

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the diyah of those whom the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم granted dhimmah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning those granted dhimmah by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم: their diyah is to be paid in full. The Imam عليه السلام confirms that the group asked about by Zurarah is included among those covered by that protection.
